name: Wei Zhang
bio:
Wei Zhang's journey in motorsport began with a childhood fascination for engineering and a deep-seated love for racing. Growing up in Shanghai, he spent countless hours tinkering with engines and studying vehicle dynamics. After graduating with a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Wei joined a local racing team, quickly rising through the ranks due to his sharp analytical skills and innovative problem-solving abilities.

Wei's approach as a technical director is rooted in meticulous data analysis and a collaborative spirit. He believes in empowering his team members, fostering an environment where ideas are freely exchanged and innovation is encouraged. Known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to identify subtle performance gains, Wei's loyalty to his team and relentless pursuit of excellence make him a valuable asset to Meyer Shank Racing. His focus is on integrating advanced simulation technologies to optimize race strategy and car setup, always seeking that crucial edge over the competition.
